newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa black-owned CNI buys stake in media firm.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa black-owned CNI buys stake in media firm.

text.p: Coordinated Network Investments (CNI), a South African black-owned investment firm, said on Thursday it had bought a 53 percent stake in business communications company Creda Press for an undisclosed sum.

"The acquisition of Creda forms part of CNI's strategy of investing in successful entertainment, communications and media companies," said chairman Reuel Khoza, who is also chairman of electricity parastatal Eskom.

CNI has investments in several information technology firms, an insurance business and is part of the Akani consortium which is bidding for a casino licence in South Africa's populous Gauteng province.
Creda owns publications including wine guides, educational books and is the largest supplier of print to government.
